en.headline: 38 arrested in New Territories South anti-illegal worker operation
en.dek: Police and Immigration Department officers raided multiple locations under Operation CHAMPION on Wednesday; those arrested face offences including illegal entry and breach of stay conditions.
body: Police and Immigration Department officers arrested 38 people during an anti-illegal worker operation in New Territories South on Wednesday, authorities said.

Officers from the regional police tactical unit and districts including Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, Lantau, Sha Tin and the Airport raided multiple locations under Operation CHAMPION. The arrested comprised six local men, 13 mainland Chinese men, two local women and 17 mainland Chinese women, aged between 26 and 73.

They were arrested on suspicion of offences including illegal entry, breach of conditions of stay, using a false instrument, possessing a forged identity card, overstaying, employing a person not lawfully employable, and aiding and abetting breach of conditions of stay.

zh.headline: 新界南反非法勞工行動拘38人
zh.dek: 警方聯同入境處星期三在新界南多處進行「冠軍」行動，被捕人士涉嫌非法入境及違反逗留條件等。
body: 警方及入境事務處表示，星期三在新界南進行反非法勞工行動，拘捕38人。
行動由新界南總區警察機動部隊及葵青、荃灣、大嶼山、沙田及機場等分區人員執行，代號「冠軍」。被捕者包括6名本地男子、13名內地男子、2名本地女子及17名內地女子，年齡介乎26至73歲。
他們涉嫌非法入境、違反逗留條件、使用虛假文書、管有偽造身份證、逾期逗留、僱用不可合法受僱的人，以及協助及教唆違反逗留條件等罪行。
